sub_answers.text: He was appointed the first Chairman of the Telangana Sahitya Akademi, an academy established to ensure research, analysis, publishing and propagation of the Telugu language [d64548874s3p0]. He headed a committee in 2014 to review Telugu language textbooks that considered whether to use the spoken Telangana dialect or the traditional form [d64548874s3p0]. He was appointed to a 2015 Telangana state government committee to design a Telangana-centric syllabus for recruitment exams, replacing the old Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission syllabus [d64548874s3p0]. He also headed a panel to select the recipient for the Kaloji Narayana Rao award and his academy organized the World Telugu Conference in Hyderabad in December 2017 [d64548874s3p0].
